question:
H, I, J, K, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. U sits fourth to the left of V. H sits fourth to the right of J. Only two people sit between V and J when counted from the left of V. K is not an immediate neighbour of H or V. I is not an immediate neighbour of K.

Who sits third to the right of W?
solution:
Given: H, I, J, K, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table..

1) U sits fourth to the left of V.

2)H sits fourth to the right of J.

3) Only two people sit between V and J when counted from the left of V.
